publishedfiledetails.title: Combined Status
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Supports all versions of Don't Starve ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=574636989]Vanilla, Reign of Giants, Shipwrecked, Hamlet[/url], Don't Starve Together).[/h1]

[h2]You can also download from [url=https://github.com/rezecib/Combined-Status/releases]GitHub[/url], although that won't auto-update for you. (code contributions also welcome via GitHub)[/h2]

This mod enhances the HUD to better show the player's stats and various information about the world, such as temperature, season, and moon phase.

This is a client-only mod, so whoever has enabled it will see the changes, and whoever doesn't won't, regardless of what server you're on and whether the server has the mod or not.

Note that unlike Kiopho's Always On Status, I use the game's temperature units directly here, so player temperature can safely vary from 0-70, with freezing/overheating warnings occurring at 5 and 65. (you can change it to C, which works like Kiopho's version, or F if you want)

Credits to Kiopho ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=180843799]Always On Status[/url]), Soilworker ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=298407615]Season Clock[/url]), and hotmatrixx ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=292558919]Better Moon[/url]) for making the original mods. I completely rewrote all of the code to be more compatible, aesthetic, and easily maintained going forward.

[h1]Configuration Options[/h1]

[table]
[tr][td][h1]Option[/h1][/td][td][h1]Description[/h1][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Temperature[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the temperature of the player. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show World Temp[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the temperature of the world. Defaults to [i]Hide[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Temp Badges[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show small images to indicate which temperature is which. Badges only get shown if this is set to [i]Show[/i] and both player and world temperatures are enabled. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Temperature Unit[/h1][/td][td]Whether to use the game's internal units (default), or approximations of Fahrenheit or Celsius.
[list][*] In [i]Game Units[/i], the player freezes at 0 and overheats at 70, with warning occurring 5 away.
[*] In [i]Celsius[/i], the player freezes at 0 and overheats at 35, with warning occurring 2.5 degrees away.
[*] In [i]Fahrenheit[/i], the player freezes at 32 and overheats at 95, with warning occurring 4.5 degrees away.
[/list][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Waning[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show if the moon is waxing or waning by adding new icons. Defaults to [i]Show[/i]. (The game normally only shows icons for one direction). In Don't Starve Together, this is now a feature of the main game, so the option doesn't do anything.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Moon[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the moon only at [i]Night[/i] (the game's default), during night and dusk ([i]Dusk[/i], the mod's default), or [i]Always[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Predict Full Moon[/h1][/td][td]Whether to predict the day of the next full moon, shown when hovering over the moon icon. Defaults to [i]Yes[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Flip Moon[/h1][/td][td]Whether to flip the moon phase icon to show it like it is in the Southern Hemisphere, instead of the default Northern Hemisphere. Defaults to [i]No[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Season Clock[/h1][/td][td][i]Clock[/i], the default, shows a full clock of the seasons. [i]Compact[/i] shows a smaller badge with the season and day count, while [i]Micro[/i] shows an even smaller badge. [i]No[/i] disables the season clock entirely.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Naughtiness[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the naughtiness of the player. Doesn't work in Don't Starve Together (unless [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2189004162]Insight[/url] is installed), as  naughtiness is not available to clients. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Log Meter[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the log meter for Woodie when he is human. Only relevant to singleplayer, as Don't Starve Together always shows the log meter already. Defaults to [i]Always[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Cave Clock[/h1][/td][td]Whether to always show the clock in the caves. Only relevant to singleplayer Reign of Giants, as the data is not available in vanilla and the clock shows in Don't Starve Together. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Stat Numbers[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the sanity, hunger, and health numbers without having to mouse over the badges. Defaults to [i]Always[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Max Text[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show the "Max:" text when hovering over the sanity, hunger, and health badges to see their maximum values. Defaults to [i]Show[/i].[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]Show Clock Text[/h1][/td][td]Whether to show text on the Clock and Season Clock. Defaults to [i]Show[/i]. If set to [i]Hide[/i], text will only be shown when mousing over or opening the Controller Inventory.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][h1]HUD Scale[/h1][/td][td]Lets you adjust the size of the badges and clocks independently of the game's HUD scale. Defaults to [i]1[/i].[/td][/tr]
[/table]

publishedfiledetails.title: 🌍组合状态[最新/中文]-Combined Status
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[hr][/hr][h1]🔎[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686] 原作者模组传送门：《Combined Status 》[/url]🔍[/h1]
[h1]🔎[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2189004162] 淘气值必须搭配Insight使用：《Insight (Show Me+)》 [/url]🔍[/h1]
[strike] “组合状态”“综合状态”“状态显示”《Combined Status》《显示三维》《三维显示》《三维》《季节时钟》《显示季节》《季节》《更多状态》《状态栏》
原作者模组传送门：\nhttps://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686
自用，仅供学习与参考【汉化者：zhonger】
模组介绍：显示饥饿值，san值，生命值，温度，季节，月相和世界总天数......
更多介绍请点击右下角【更多信息】 [/strike]
[code] 当地球位于月球和太阳之间时，我们可以看到整个被太阳直射的月球部分，这就是满月。当月球位于地球和太阳之间时，我们只能看到月球不被太阳照射的部分，这就是朔月；而当首度再见到月球明亮的部分时，称为“新月”。当地月联线和日地联线正好成直角时，我们正好可以看到月球被太阳直射的部分的一半，这就是上弦月。
月相变化的顺序是：新月–蛾眉月–上弦月–盈凸–满月–亏凸–下弦月–残月–新月，就这样循环，月相变化是周期性的，周期大约是一个月。[/code] 
[hr][/hr][h1] 🌍模组介绍 [/h1]
“玩家体温”【显示玩家的体温。】“已开启”
“世界温度”【显示世界的温度。（这不考虑诸如火等热源）。】“已关闭”
“温度图标”【在【玩家体温】和【世界温度】的左边显示小图标，方便辨认每个温度的含义。】“图标+数字”[spoiler]
图标+数字：更直观的图标显示+数字显示。（仅当两个温度都被显示时，才会显示图标）。
数字：更简洁的数字显示。 [/spoiler]
“温度单位”【选择您想要的温度单位。（原作者的小吐槽）华氏度：你喜欢但没有意义的温度单位。】“游戏单位”[spoiler]
游戏单位：游戏使用的温度单位。0过冷-70过热（每5度警示一次）。
摄氏度：游戏使用的温度单位，但减半后更为合理。0过冷-35过热（每2.5度警示一次）。
华氏度：游戏使用的温度单位，但翻倍后更为直观。32过冷-158过热（每9度警示一次）。 [/spoiler]
“提醒月圆”【分别展示出盈月和亏月的月相。（在【饥荒联机版】没用，因为联机版自带这个功能）。】“已开启”
“显示月相”【白天+黄昏+夜晚显示月相的图标。】“黄昏+夜晚”[spoiler]
夜晚：和往常一样，仅在夜晚显示月相图标。
黄昏+夜晚：仅在黄昏和夜晚显示月相图标。
白天+黄昏+夜晚[推荐]：全天显示月相图标。 [/spoiler]
“预测月圆”【月圆当天提醒月圆。】“已开启”
“翻转月相”【镜像翻转月相的图标，让月亮显示为在南半球的样子（确实是恢复了旧版的行为方式）。在南半球的月亮是C形，在北半球的月亮是反C形）。】“默认”[spoiler]
翻转：和南半球的月相一致。
默认：和中国的月相一致。 [/spoiler]
“季节时钟”【添加一个显示季节的时钟，并重新排列右上角全部图标，让整体布局更合理。或者，添加一个图标，显示进入季节的天数和鼠标悬停时剩余的天数。】“时钟版[推荐]”
[strike]“淘气值”【显示玩家淘气值，淘气值升满时会有坎普斯（小偷）来攻击玩家。此功能无法在【饥荒联机版】中直接使用（除非订阅了模组：Insight）。】“已开启” [/strike]
[strike]“原木值”【当伍迪是人类时，显示他的原木值。 此功能无法在【饥荒联机版】中使用。】“已开启（Always始终）” [/strike]
[strike]“洞穴时钟”【在洞穴中显示时钟。仅适用于【巨人国的统治】单人游戏。】“已开启” [/strike]
“状态数值”【选择您想显示【饥饿值，san值，生命值】的数字样式。】“当前”
“最大值提示”【在【饥饿值，san值，生命值】到达最大数值时显示“Max:”使其更直观。】“已开启”
“季节时钟拓展”【【已开启】：始终显示天数和当前季节【已关闭】：鼠标悬浮在季节时钟时显示信息】“已开启”
“HUD大小”【让您可以独立于游戏的HUD比例调整此模组图标和时钟的大小。【官方解释（HUD大小：自定义抬头显示的大小）】】“1”


[code] 首先，感謝作者rezecib願意讓我翻譯，你可以在這裡看到成果：
成果第一張、成果第二張。
你可以在這裡看到文本內容：https://pastebin.com/7AWE3hLV。
我把檔案放在我的MEGA免空，但是這個討論區會刪除連結，所以我只好把下載連結集中放在我的部落格[evaandmaicy.blogspot.tw]
檔案的位置是SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Don't Starve Together\mods\workshop-376333686，請下載之後直接用替換的方式把modinfo蓋過去。

配置選項
選項
描述
體溫
設定是否顯示玩家的體溫。預設是顯示。
顯示氣溫
設定是否顯示氣溫。預設是隱藏。
顯示小圖示
在體溫和氣溫指數的左邊標上小圖示來方便辨認。預設是顯示。
溫度單位
可選擇遊戲溫度(預設)、攝氏或華氏。
　遊戲溫度：在0度凍結，在70度過熱，每5度得到警示。
　攝氏：在0度凍結，在35度過熱，每2.5度得到警示。
　華氏：在32度凍結，在95度過熱，每4.5度得到警示。
顯示月光變化
月相減少時也顯現出來。預設是顯示。(遊戲原本的功能只會顯現月相增加的樣子)。在多人版，這已經是內建的功能。
顯示月光狀態
設定要在哪個時段顯示月光狀態。預設是只在晚上，也可以選黃昏和晚上顯示，或者全天候顯示。
預測滿月
預測下一個滿月的天數。當滑鼠移到標示上面時顯示。預設是顯示。
翻轉月亮
翻轉月相，讓它變成位於南半球的人所習慣看到的月相。預設是"否"，顯示北半球的月相。
季節時鐘
增加顯示季節的時鐘。預設是時鐘的模樣。也可以選擇緊湊型、最簡易型，和不顯示。
罪惡值
設定是否顯示玩家的罪惡值。預設是顯示。此功能無法在多人版使用（除非安装了Insight）。
海狸值
當伍迪(Woodie)還是人類狀態的時候就顯示海狸值。預設是顯示。在多人版，這已經是內建的功能。
洞穴時鐘
在洞穴中顯示時鐘。預設示顯示。此功能只適用於Reign of Giants的單人遊戲，原味單人無法使用。在多人版，這已經是內建的功能。
狀態值
不需要滑鼠移到標示上面才能看，直接顯示當前的健康、飢餓度和血量的數字在圖示下面。預設是永遠顯示。
顯示狀態最大值
滑鼠移到標示上面就能看到該狀態的最大值時多少。預設是顯示。
HUD比例
讓你可以自由調整整個狀態界面的整體大小。預設值為1。 [/code]

publishedfiledetails.title: Beefalo Status Bar
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Beefalo Status Bar[/h1]
It shows up when you mount a beefalo, goes away when you dismount. You can also toggle it on or off (when mounted) if you feel like it's getting in your way.
Note that toggling will override the "Show Automatically" setting for the current shard session (going in and out of the caves or reloading will reset it to whatever it was originally set to).


[h1]Information[/h1]
Most everything should be pretty straight forward, except maybe the tendency and the hunger badge, so let me explain.

[h1]Domestication and Tendency:[/h1]
The color of the domestication badge will reflect the current tendency of your beefalo. This is configurable, but by default it goes like this:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/bHMl3Sb.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/877HBr0.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/Mk7X39h.png ] [img=https://i.imgur.com/LtxSAfE.png ]

There are 13 colors (8 unique and 5 variations) to choose from.

Note: Last I checked, the only time the game tries to make your beefalo domesticated is when you feed it. This means that when you reach 100% domestication your beefalo won't become domesticated until you feed it something.

[h1]Ride Timer:[/h1]
This badge shows how much time you have left riding your beefalo before it bucks you off. Hovering over it will show you how many uses your saddle has left.
[b]Note[/b]: Your saddle will [b]NOT[/b] lose durability when the timer runs out. The only time this happens is when the beefalo shakes it off it's back.

[h1]Hunger Badge:[/h1]
Your beefalo needs to have at least 15 hunger (configurable) at mount time to activate the hunger badge. Once activated, when the beefalo's hunger reaches 0 it will deactivate itself again.
This should be low enough to easily trigger it while still in the process of domestication, but high enough to almost never see it once your beefalo is fully domesticated.


[h1]F.A.Q.[/h1]
[b]I don't see the numbers below the badges, why?[/b]
- They are a feature of another mod called [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url][/b]. In order to see them you will need to download/subscribe to it (and enable it). [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Click here[/url] to do just that.

[b]Can you make this a client only mod?[/b]
- No. Unfortunately, the beefalo information is not available on the client, so a client only version is not possible.

[b]I'm using a HUD reskin mod, how do I make this mod use the reskinned badges?[/b]
- Set the "Theme" option to "Default Theme".


[h1]Latest Changelog:[/h1]
[h1]v1.4.0[/h1]
[h1]General[/h1]
- Added support for resetting the ride timer by raising obedience when mounted.
- Added Beige color (or close to it) as a color choice for all badges.
- Changed the default domestication badge color for "Default" beefalo from White to Beige.
- Increased the default hunger badge threshold from 10 to 15.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue causing the Status Bar to move up a little bit each time the player changes characters when using The Forge theme without Combined Status.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
- A small backend change for future-proofing that will hopefully not cause any trouble.

[h3]Notes:[/h3]
- In the upcoming game update, beefalo can be fed while mounted. This will increase their obedience (unless already maxed out), which will reset the ride timer. In case other scenarios where obedience is raised while riding are to be added in the future (like brushing for example), they should be properly accounted for as well.
- Due to how mod configurations work in the game, if you already have a saved configuration the new defaults may not be properly reflected until you reset or change them manually.

publishedfiledetails.title: Status Announcements
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]How it works[/b][/h1]
ALT(+SHIFT)+click parts of the HUD to announce their status ("I'm wounded!", "I have 2 twigs.", "We need more drying racks."). For controllers, the announce buttons show up on the HUD when in Inventory or Crafting mode. (SHIFT is needed for inventory items, because ALT+click already examines them). 

Holding CTRL in addition will cause it to whisper (or if you have it set to whisper by default, it will announce it globally). For controllers, hold Menu Misc 3, which by default is left-stick-click.

Each character has their own quotes, and custom characters can define their own quotes (see below).

Also available on [url=https://github.com/rezecib/Status-Announcements/releases]GitHub[/url].

If you find this mod super annoying, there's also an option ("Hide Announcements") to mute all uses of it (you won't see announcements from yourself or anyone else).

[h1][b]Configuration Options[/b][/h1]
Whisper by default: If toggled on, then you will whisper unless you hold ctrl.
Show current/max: If toggled on, then you will announce your current/max health, sanity, and hunger.
Custom X Quotes: If toggled off, X (one of the characters) will use default quotes instead of the custom ones written in their voice.


[h1][b]List of things you can announce[/b][/h1]
[list][*] [b]Current hunger/health/sanity/wetness/log/temperature[/b] status. Alt+clicking your health badge will announce "I'm in perfect health!" if your health is full, or "I'm mortally wounded!" if it's very low. Sanity and hunger have different announcements specific to them ("AAAH! Stay back, beasts of darkness!"). Announcing temperature requires [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url].
[*] [b]Craftable items[/b] in the craft tabs. If you know how to build it and you have the supplies, it will announce that you'll make one. If you don't know how to build it, it will ask if someone can make you one (e.g. you have a Wickerbottom and no science machine yet, and you want her to make you a backpack). If you know how to make one, but don't have the supplies for it, it will say "We need more [craftable]s". You can also announce item skins you have.
[*] [b]Ingredients[/b] for crafted items. Let's say night is falling and you have two twigs and one grass. Alt+clicking the grass in the torch recipe will announce "I need 1 more cut grass for a torch.".
[*] [b]Items in your inventory and backpack[/b]. Since alt+click already does something for these, you'll have to hold down shift as well. This will announce that you have the item, and how many: "I have 10 dragonpies."
[*] [b]Items in chests or other containers[/b]. This works the same way as inventory ones, but will announce something like "We have 8 dragonpies here in this icebox".[/list]

[h1][b]Custom Announcements for Character Mods[/b][/h1]
Character mods can add their own quotes if they want. You don't need to worry about mod load order, just add the quotes to GLOBAL.STRINGS._STATUS_ANNOUNCEMENTS (make sure to check if it exists first, and if not, make it an empty table before adding your strings). See announcestrings.lua in the files for this mod on the format of the announcement strings. If you want to see an example of how to do this, look at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=645436044]Elec Man[/url]. In addition, it's now possible to add announcements for stats that only your character has. There's a small guide inside the modmain, I recommend looking at that; you may need to refer to some other code there.

[h1][b]Translations[/b][/h1]
I have support for translations. However, I don't know all languages so if you're willing to translate the mod, then here's how to do it. If you're subscribed to the mod, then go to the game in Steam, click Properties, then the Local Files tab, then Browse Local files. Navigate to mods/workshop-343753877. Make a copy of announcestrings_english.lua and open it in a text editor (Notepad, Notepad++, Sublime, whatever). Translate all the strings and update the format and article parts at the top. Feel free to contact me to ask how those work if you need help writing it into the code there. Send me the translated file (for example, by uploading to pastebin.com and sending me the link), and I'll add in support for it-- I look at mods on the workshop that translate into that language, and then have this mod detect them and switch to the provided translations.

Currently supported languages:
[list][*] English (default)
[*] Brazilian Portuguese (thanks to Vinicius Araújo for translating!)
[*] Chinese (thanks to GoforDream and Shang for translating!)
[*] Spanish (thanks to Gum and oPt for translating)
[*] Russian, incomplete (thanks to deshkas and Shiro for translating)
[*] German (thanks to Redhead for translating)
[/list]

Requested languages:
[list][*] Let me know if you want one or want to help provide one.
[*] French; if you know French and would like to write lines in keeping with the characters, please reach out to me :)
[/list]

[h1][b]Acknowledgements[/b][/h1]
Thanks for SilentDarkness, SuperPsiPower, OSMRhodey, AceMurdock, and Lying Cake for help writing the character-specific strings.

[h1][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Because mods can't directly have their own keybindings, I'm using some of the game bindings to allow you to rebind ALT/SHIFT/CTRL. So if you've rebound any of the following, use those instead:
[list][*] "Force Inspect (mod)" (default ALT) the main announcement key
[*] "Force Container (mod)" (default SHIFT) press this as well to announce inventory items
[*] "Force Attack (mod)" (default CTRL) press this as well to toggle whispering
[/list]
[*] Sometimes alt gets stuck when alt-tabbing. Pressing alt again should fix it.
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Repair Combine
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
With this mod you can repair your equipment with the same equipment.

So you can combine a logsuit with 10% and a logsuit with 30% to a logsuit with 40%!

[u]This mod works for things with:[/u]
[b]finiteuses (like weapons), armor, fueled and perishable+equipable[/b].

Added in modsettings "bonus durability". By default it is off.
You can choose from +1% to +10% or even randomly. Also negative bonus is possible, if you prefer.
So when combining a 30% item and a 40% item, you may get an item with up to 80% if you wish so.

Also works correctly for stackables like Bull Kelp Stalk and mod items.


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198102311542/myworkshopfiles/?appid=322330] [h1][u]Also take a look at other mods I made, see my workshop ;)[/u][/h1] [/url]

DS version from another author:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1532277729


[u]Update 12.12.2019:[/u]
- Added option to disable/enable repair-combine for specific components. (all enabled by default)
So if you want to be able to repair-combine weapons/tools (finiteuses) but not anything fuelable or perishable, you can change the settings accordingly.

- Added option to also increase the max values! (disabled by default)
A spear usually has a max usage of 150. 
If this setting is enabled, and you combine 2 full spears, you will get one spear with 300 of 300 uses (will still show 100%). 
If you combine instead a spear with 100 uses left (66.6%) and a spear with 60 uses left (33.3%), you will get a spear with 160 of 160 uses left (100%).
For fueled items, like a lantern, this means after combinging eg. 10 full lanters, the new lantern can hold 10 times more fuel.
I highly recommend a mod like "Insight" to show you the current/max uses of an item, since the percentages will be confusing with these "overmax" settings enabled.


In case I get inactive and do not respond to bugfixes/feature requests, everyone is free to fork this or other of my mods to fix/expand them, but please link to the original. As long as I'm responding also feel free to write new/better code for it and I may upload it and add you as author if you want.

publishedfiledetails.title: Craft Pot [DS, ROG, SW, DST]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Client mod that adds intuitive cook assisting interface to crock pot.

Doesn't matter what server you join, modded crock pots, modded recipes, this mod serves them all on a plate and helps you cook whatever your heart desires by displaying the exact recipe.
 

[b]What's in this mod:[/b]
- 1. All cooking recipes (INCLUDING MODDED) are listed in a slider next to crock pot;
- 2. Hovering over recipe shows ingredient requirements for it as well as food status of the dish;
- 3. Filling crock pot with ingredients will gradually predict dishes you want to cook;
- 4. Recipe turns green if you put all the required ingredients, just fill crockpot with fillers and it's done;
- 5. Recipe disappears from the list, if you put a bad ingredient;
- 6. Once crockpot is full, the resulting recipe will get painted teal. If you see more than one teal recipe, this means result is unpredictable, cooking will result in one of the highlighted dishes;
- 7. Mod works with any pot that takes 4 ingredients (including warly's portable pot and any modded crockpot)
- 8. You do not need to restart game to make the mod work.
- 9. Full CONTROLLER support

[b]Currently mode has following options:[/b]
- 1. lock uncooked, enabled by default. This option adds a 'recipe lock' simillar to the one in crafting menu, once you cooked an item, the lock disappears and hovering over the dish in the list will show it's hunger/health/sanity values. You may disable and enable it at any time, the progress of cooking will be saved
- 2. Invert controller - by default craftpot scrollbar works with left wiggle (right wiggle used to move items around), checking invert controller makes it work with right wiggle (left wiggle used to move items around).
- 3. Ingredient Popup - by default it is shown, but you can hide it, so that there is only a slider with dishes, no popup with name or stats.

[b]For modders:[/b]
Craftpot exposes the following mod APIs:
1. An API to add images and names for food ingredient tags:
- global 'AddFoodTag' function and a matching FOODTAGDEFINITIONS global dict;
2. An API to registed modded cookpots, for now they do not take extra arguments, but in future they might allow passing custom fields, such as slot number:
- global 'AddCookingPot' function and a matching COOKINGPOTS global dictionary;

It is preferred that during modding you use the provided functions, as they already contain all the safety precautions. But if for some reason the functions are not available during your mod initialization, you can use the dictionaries straight away, but make sure you do not erase the object, that could be prefilled by another mod before you.

[b]DS, ROG, SW version:[/b] http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=662872357

For people off steam, here's a [url=https://github.com/IMalyugin/craftpot]secret link[/url]

中文翻译简介@WendyPan: https://github.com/IMalyugin/craftpot/wiki/chinese

Enjoy :)
